title: WEBINAR: Cut down EDA License cost by 25% with Stratos AI Nitro
gist: A promotional post for a November 10, 2026 SemiWiki webinar in which Tuple Technologies CTO Anirudh Kothur demos Stratos AI Nitro. Nitro unifies EDA license and job-queue data (SLURM, LSF, SGE) and claims teams can target 20-25% license cost cuts by reclaiming idle seats and underused tools. It also adds AI natural-language querying and MCP integration.

themes.theme: EDA license waste and cost reduction

insights.claim: When EDA license activity and job queues live in separate systems, chip design teams struggle to see why work is waiting, which tools are underused and whether more spending will help, so idle seats, checkout failures and stalled jobs consume budgets.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: EDA license spend is a large, poorly measured cost line at chip design firms.
